Current source always returns PARTIAL_COVERAGE with every value withheld; it cannot publish metrics by turning a flag on.

Verify this producer's signature against immutable PROCESSED native event identity/unit fingerprint; atomically record monotonic context history/head. Signed revocations remain ingestible when report reads are killed. No membership completeness assertion or approval issuance. Body maximum 32 KiB.

get.description: Default off. Return only a native PROCESSED event/unit fingerprint, source contract and known canonical product for independent owner review. Unknown geography/organization/tenant remain empty. No context grant, signature or completeness assertion. Immutable audit must commit before disclosure. Report/unit kind is fixed to the ten lineage reports and five explicitly supported native unit fields. HQ read credentials cannot prepare bindings.

ScopedServiceHMAC.name: X-Service-Signature
ScopedServiceHMAC.description: Dedicated admin-backoffice-service HMAC v2 key, distinct from every legacy Analytics audience. Exact method/path/query/body, name/version/timestamp/nonce headers and durable cross-replica replay protection.

ProducerPublicationHMAC.name: X-Service-Signature
ProducerPublicationHMAC.description: Separate per-owner publisher workload secret, caller owner-authorization-context-publisher, exact body/path/query HMAC v2 and durable replay protection. Every document additionally requires an independent Ed25519 signature from the pinned source owner. No HQ authority.
